description: Get the EU legal basis (directives and regulations) that a Belgian statute implements, supplements, or references. Returns EU document identifiers (CELEX numbers), directive/regulation references, and implementation status. Use this to trace which EU law a Belgian statute is based on — essential for EU compliance analysis. Example: find that a Belgian data protection law implements GDPR (Regulation 2016/679).

include_articles.description: Include specific EU article references (default: false).

name: get_eu_basis
